Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s results and incorrectly identified the "Victim of Romance" performer as Mackenzie Phillips instead of Michelle Phillips. This conflation of Michelle (the actual performer) with her daughter Mackenzie led the Planner to search for and report Mackenzie’s child (Shane Barakan), producing the wrong final answer instead of Michelle Phillips’s child (Chynna Phillips).
